invalid_date: Dates such as first payment date must occur after the origination date.
balance_inconsistency: Current UPB should not exceed Original UPB by more than 5%.
prepayment_conflict: A record cannot be flagged as Prepaid (code 1) if it still has a positive UPB.
stale_record: Loan age must increment over time. Frozen loan age implies stale servicing data.
